label: sparse: tokens h/1/i/j/t/r around sequence positions 2-4 (no clean rule)
explanation: Very sparse feature (0.04% of steps). It fires mostly when the input is h, 1, i, j, t or r, at original positions 2-3 or at copy steps that output original tokens 3-4 (input = original token 2-3 fed back). That covers about 70% of activation mass, but precision is only ~0.5%: these tokens at these positions almost never activate it. Firing seems to depend on particular token combinations earlier in the sequence (e.g. the e z g prefix gives the top activations, and z-g bigrams have 7-9x lift), but no simple history predicate captures this (prev2=z & prev=g gives F1 0.07). It never fires at t=0-1 and rarely on the delimiter. Magnitude varies little (median 0.118, max 0.23), and I found no clear modulator.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: t=2 & prev_tok=g (+5.75), phase=2 & in_tok=h (+5.02), phase=2 & in_tok=1 (+4.97), t=3 & prev_tok=g (+4.33), out_tok=h (+3.50), in_tok=i (+3.37). Lower it: prev_tok=<DEL> (-3.98), t=7 (-2.96), t=9 (-2.96), t=8 (-2.75).
